001package org.clafer.collection;
002
003import java.io.Serializable;
004import java.lang.reflect.Array;
005import java.util.ArrayList;
006import java.util.HashMap;
007import java.util.List;
008import java.util.Map;
009import java.util.Map.Entry;
010import java.util.function.BiPredicate;
011import java.util.function.Predicate;
012import org.clafer.common.Check;
013
014/**
015 * A 2-tuple.
016 *
017 *
018 * @param <A> the type of fst
019 * @param <B> the type of snd
020 * @author jimmy
021 */
022public class Pair<A, B> implements Serializable {
023
024    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1;
025    private final A fst;
026    private final B snd;
027
028    /**
029     * Construct a tuple.
030     *
031     * @param fst
032     * @param snd
033     */
034    public Pair(A fst, B snd) {
035        this.fst = Check.notNull(fst);
036        this.snd = Check.notNull(snd);
037    }
038
039    public Pair(Pair<? extends A, ? extends B> pair) {
040        this(pair.getFst(), pair.getSnd());
041    }
042
043    public A getFst() {
044        return fst;
045    }
046
047    public B getSnd() {
048        return snd;
049    }
050
051    /**
052     * Returns the first element of the tuples in the same order. Equivalent to
053     * the Haskell code {@code map fst}.
054     *
055     * @param <A> the type of first element in the pairs
056     * @param <B> the type of second element in the pairs
057     * @param pairs the tuples
058     * @return the first element of the tuples
059     */
060    public static <A, B> List<A> mapFst(List<Pair<A, B>> pairs) {
061        List<A> fsts = new ArrayList<>(pairs.size());
062        for (Pair<A, B> pair : pairs) {
063            fsts.add(pair.getFst());
064        }
065        return fsts;
066    }
067
068    /**
069     * Returns the first element of the tuples in the same order. Equivalent to
070     * the Haskell code {@code map fst}.
071     *
072     * @param <A> the type of first element in the pairs
073     * @param <B> the type of second element in the pairs
074     * @param pairs the tuples
075     * @param array the array to write to if the size is correct
076     * @return the first element of the tuples
077     */
078    @SafeVarargs
079    public static <A, B> A[] mapFst(Pair<A, B>[] pairs, A... array) {
080        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
081        A[] to = array.length == pairs.length
082                ? array
083                : (A[]) Array.newInstance(array.getClass().getComponentType(), pairs.length);
084        for (int i = 0; i < to.length; i++) {
085            to[i] = pairs[i].getFst();
086        }
087        return to;
088    }
089
090    /**
091     * Returns the second element of the tuples in the same order. Equivalent to
092     * the Haskell code {@code map snd}.
093     *
094     * @param <A> the type of first element in the pairs
095     * @param <B> the type of second element in the pairs
096     * @param pairs the tuples
097     * @return the second element of the tuples
098     */
099    public static <A, B> List<B> mapSnd(List<Pair<A, B>> pairs) {
100        List<B> snds = new ArrayList<>(pairs.size());
101        for (Pair<A, B> pair : pairs) {
102            snds.add(pair.getSnd());
103        }
104        return snds;
105    }
106
107    /**
108     * Returns the second element of the tuples in the same order. Equivalent to
109     * the Haskell code {@code map snd}.
110     *
111     * @param <A> the type of first element in the pairs
112     * @param <B> the type of second element in the pairs
113     * @param pairs the tuples
114     * @param array the array to write to if the size is correct
115     * @return the second element of the tuples
116     */
117    @SafeVarargs
118    public static <A, B> B[] mapSnd(Pair<A, B>[] pairs, B... array) {
119        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
120        B[] to = array.length == pairs.length
121                ? array
122                : (B[]) Array.newInstance(array.getClass().getComponentType(), pairs.length);
123        for (int i = 0; i < to.length; i++) {
124            to[i] = pairs[i].getSnd();
125        }
126        return to;
127    }
128
129    /**
130     * Return a map from a list of key/value pairs. If a key appears multiple
131     * times in the list, the last pair overrides the others.
132     *
133     * @param <A> the type of key
134     * @param <B> the type of value
135     * @param pairs the list of key/value pairs
136     * @return a map from a list of key/value pairs
137     */
138    @SafeVarargs
139    public static <A, B> Map<A, B> fromPairs(Pair<A, B>... pairs) {
140        Map<A, B> map = new HashMap<>();
141        for (Pair<A, B> pair : pairs) {
142            map.put(pair.getFst(), pair.getSnd());
143        }
144        return map;
145    }
146
147    /**
148     * Return a list of key/value pairs from a map.
149     *
150     * @param <A> the type of key
151     * @param <B> the type of value
152     * @param map the map
153     * @return a list of key/value pairs from a map
154     */
155    public static <A, B> Pair<A, B>[] toPairs(Map<A, B> map) {
156        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
157        Pair<A, B>[] pairs = (Pair<A, B>[]) new Pair<?, ?>[map.size()];
158        int i = 0;
159        for (Entry<A, B> entry : map.entrySet()) {
160            pairs[i++] = new Pair<>(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
161        }
162        assert i == pairs.length;
163        return pairs;
164    }
165
166    public static <A, B> Predicate<Pair<A, B>> uncurry(BiPredicate<A, B> function) {
167        return p -> function.test(p.fst, p.snd);
168    }
169
170    @Override
171    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
172        if (obj instanceof Pair<?, ?>) {
173            Pair<?, ?> other = (Pair<?, ?>) obj;
174            return fst.equals(other.fst) && snd.equals(other.snd);
175        }
176        return false;
177    }
178
179    @Override
180    public int hashCode() {
181        return fst.hashCode() ^ snd.hashCode();
182    }
183
184    @Override
185    public String toString() {
186        return "(" + fst + ", " + snd + ")";
187    }
188}
